name: Alappuzha Town Centre
tagline: The walkable hub near beach and station
description: The compact heart of Alappuzha, close to the beach, railway station, and everyday shops and eateries. It is the most convenient base for transport and errands, with autorickshaws everywhere and easy access to backwater boat jetties, though it trades tranquillity for bustle.
pros: Close to railway station and beach
Cheap food and everyday amenities nearby
cons: Busier and noisier than the outskirts

name: Punnamada
description: The backwater zone just north of town, famous as the houseboat hub and the finishing point of the Nehru Trophy snake-boat race on Punnamada Lake. Waterside resorts and boarding points make it scenic and atmospheric, ideal for those drawn to Vembanad Lake and slow cruises.
pros: Direct access to houseboats and backwaters

name: Mararikulam (Marari Beach)
description: A relaxed fishing-village coast north of Alappuzha, home to Marari Beach and a cluster of homestays, boutique resorts, and quieter beachfront guesthouses. It offers the calmest, most restorative base in the area, with palm-fringed sand and a gentle, unhurried pace well suited to long stays.
bestFor: Beach-focused slow travellers and long stays
pros: Restful and workable for slow travel

name: Kuttanad
description: The rural backwater region south and east of town, known for its below-sea-level paddy fields, canals, and traditional village life across Vembanad's waterways. It is deeply scenic and authentic, best for those wanting immersion in Kerala's farming and boating culture rather than urban convenience.
